operation_details.item: The user resolved the payment gateway incident.

conversation.message: Morning—how’s the payment gateway work looking today?

conversation.message: Morning. I resolved the payment gateway incident and confirmed the service is back to normal.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good to hear. Did you capture what happened while it was still fresh?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the incident timeline is documented. I’m still working through the root cause analysis.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Are you planning to review it with the team soon?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: A postmortem is scheduled for next week, so I’ll bring the analysis there.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I resolved the payment gateway incident; keep the timeline, root cause work, and postmortem.
